instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a 'Light Mode' first design. Do not assume Dark Mode is needed unless toggled.
Use 'Manrope' for all headings to give a modern, friendly medical feel.
Use 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text for maximum legibility.
The Primary Color is Purple (#6B21A8). Use this for Headers, Text Highlights, and Primary Icons.
The Secondary Color is Amber/Orange (#F59E0B). CRITICAL: Use this for 'Call to Action' buttons (Book Appointment, Call Emergency). It stands out against the white/purple theme.
Create a 'Sticky Header' that always shows the Emergency Number and 'Book Appointment' button.
ESIC Pillar Page: Make this section distinct. Use a soft purple background (bg-purple-50) with clear steps.
Forms: Use Shadcn UI components (Dialog, Input, Select, Calendar). Customize them to have rounded corners (rounded-lg) and soft borders.
Animations: Add subtle 'fade-in-up' animations to sections as they scroll into view. Use 'hover:scale-105' for cards.
Mobile Responsiveness: Ensure the Navbar collapses into a Hamburger menu on mobile. Add a fixed bottom bar on mobile with 'Call' and 'Book' buttons.
SEO: Ensure <h1> tags are used for main headings and <h2> for section headings. Add alt text to all images.
Data-TestID: Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links) as per the rules.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Don't make generic centered layouts. Use split layouts, grids, and asymmetry where appropriate.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for overlays.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions (transition-colors, transition-transform).
You MUST NOT center align the app container. This disrupts natural reading flow.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or rounded-lg).
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover, focus, active).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable (p-8, p-12, py-24).
